results.content: The August data extends a turbulent stretch for consumer confidence that began when conflict in the Middle East disrupted oil markets and drove up gasoline prices. Sentiment rebounded in June from a record low set in May, when the index fell to 44.8 amid surging pump prices and deepening concern that inflation would spread beyond fuel costs. The June recovery was driven in part by falling gasoline prices, though consumers remained worried about the cost of living. # CPI report shows inflation eased in July to a 3.4% annual pace

Updated on: August 12, 2026 / 2:20 PM EDT
/ CBS News

Inflation eased for the second consecutive month, rising at a 3.4% annual pace in July, in line with economists' expectations and a signal that some consumer price pressures may be easing.

## By the numbers

Economists polled by the financial data firm FactSet predicted July inflation rose at an annual rate of 3.4%.
